correctness.rationale: Proof reconstructed: coefficientwise prime-index Touchard congruence gives p-divisibility on all integer inputs. Forward difference Δ^p of monic degree-p f equals p!, so ν_p(d_p)=1. Mod q, recurrence u_(n+q)=u_(n+1)+xu_n has characteristic Artin–Schreier H_x(Y)=Y^q−Y−x; for x≠0 its nonzero simple roots lie in F_(q^q) by Frobenius translation, giving period q^q−1 for all positive indices. Dirichlet applies because gcd(q,q^q−1)=1. For q=2,3 independent full modular-function periodic-index enumeration gave unique matching index 2 (period 3), 3 (period 26). Proved period is not asserted minimal; finite check only establishes small-prime residues.
